mini_task_spec:
In the `test-repo/` NestJS codebase, use the graphquery brick to find all nodes in `packages/core/` that are "neighbors" of the `GraphInspector` node (i.e., all non-test TypeScript source files that directly import `GraphInspector`). Specifically: query the knowledge graph for all source-file nodes that have an incoming or outgoing dependency edge to `GraphInspector`, excluding any test or spec files (files under `test/` directories or with `.spec.ts` extensions). List the file paths relative to `test-repo/`, one per line, sorted alphabetically.

Expected answer format: list of relative file paths (relative to `test-repo/`), one per line, sorted alphabetically.
